name: RSI Oversold Reversion
description: Scores oversold symbols where RSI is below threshold and starting to curl up.

name: MACD Bullish Crossover
description: Scores symbols where MACD line crosses above the signal line.

name: Price Above EMA Structure
description: Scores symbols where price sits above EMA20 which sits above EMA50.

name: ATR Normalized Dip
description: Scores pullback quality using ATR-normalized distance from recent high.

name: Volume Confirmation
description: Scores symbols where recent volume exceeds the average.

name: Money Flow Index
description: Volume-weighted RSI. MFI < 20 = oversold accumulation. MFI > 80 = overbought distribution.

name: Average Directional Index
description: Measures trend strength. ADX > 25 = trending. +DI > -DI = bullish bias. Scores trend conviction.

name: Stochastic Oscillator
description: Momentum oscillator. %K < 20 with crossover = oversold bounce. %K > 80 = overbought.

name: RSI Overbought Warning
description: Scores overbought symbols where RSI > 70 and starting to curl down. Anti-long signal.

name: Momentum Continuation Combo
description: Composite: trend alignment (EMA20) + momentum (MACD histogram) + volume confirmation.

name: Speed Momentum
description: Short-term price velocity over 5 candles, amplified by volume confirmation. Core signal for speed/scalp trading on M1-M15 timeframes.

name: Multi-Timeframe Trend Alignment
description: Scores trend alignment across daily, hourly, and 15M timeframes using EMA structure, ADX strength, and VWAP position. Higher confidence when all timeframes agree.

name: Micro Support & Resistance Levels
description: Identifies key short-timeframe S/R levels from prior day extremes, session ranges, VWAP, round numbers, and swing pivots. Scores proximity and bounce/rejection patterns for speed trading.

name: Price Above SMA 50
description: Scores price position relative to 50-period SMA. Above = bullish trend. Below = bearish.

name: MA Crossover
description: Detects fast EMA crossing above/below slow EMA. Scores crossover freshness and separation.

name: Moving Averages Alignment
description: Bullish MA alignment (20>50>200).

name: Bollinger Bands
description: Scores price position relative to Bollinger Bands (20,2). Near lower band = bullish, near upper = bearish.

name: Commodity Channel Index
description: Measures price vs statistical mean. CCI < -100 = oversold bounce. CCI > 100 = overbought.

name: Bollinger Band Squeeze
description: Detects bandwidth at multi-period low — signals imminent volatility expansion.

name: Volatility Calculator
description: Historical vol, ATR percentile, beta proxy utility.

name: On-Balance Volume
description: Cumulative volume indicator. OBV confirming price = accumulation. OBV diverging = potential reversal.

name: Volume Rhythm
description: Day-of-week volume pattern analysis. Higher score when up-day volume exceeds down-day volume.

name: VWAP
description: Price relative to VWAP. Above = bullish intraday sentiment, below = bearish.

name: Volume Surge Detection
description: Detects extreme volume spikes (>3x average). Surge on up day = accumulation, on down day = capitulation.

name: RSI Divergence Scanner
description: Detects bullish/bearish RSI divergence — price making new extremes while RSI fails to confirm. Strong reversal signal.

name: MACD Divergence Scanner
description: Detects bullish/bearish MACD histogram divergence — price making new extremes while MACD momentum fails to confirm. Stronger than RSI divergence.

name: OBV Divergence Scanner
description: Detects bullish/bearish OBV (On-Balance Volume) divergence — price extremes not confirmed by volume flow. Strongest divergence signal — indicates smart money accumulation/distribution.

name: VWAP Confluence (Simple AND-Gate)
description: Price at VWAP + RSI confirming + volume elevated = high-confidence mean-reversion entry. Prop-firm staple.

name: VWAP Confluence (Full Bands)
description: VWAP ±1σ/±2σ standard deviation bands. Price in -2σ zone = deep discount (strong buy). Price in +2σ zone = overextended (bearish). Precision entries at institutional levels.

name: MTF Confluence (Conservative — ALL 3 Aligned)
description: All 3 timeframes (daily, 1h, 15m) must be bullish for BUY. High-accuracy, low-frequency. ~3-5 signals/month on SPY.

name: MTF Confluence (Weighted — 50/35/15 Composite)
description: 50/35/15 macro/meso/micro composite. Composite > 0.3 = bullish. ~15-20 signals/month on SPY.

name: Pre-Market Gap Scanner
description: Detects overnight/opening price gaps. Small gaps (0.5-2%) tend to fill — fade the gap. Large gaps (>2%) may gap-and-go — follow momentum. Extreme gaps (>5%) are news-driven and unpredictable.

name: Doji Pattern
description: Detects indecision candles where open and close are nearly equal. Scores bullish at support, bearish at resistance.

name: Hammer Pattern
description: Detects hammer-style reversal candles — small body with long lower wick rejecting lower prices.

name: Engulfing Pattern
description: Detects bullish/bearish engulfing reversal structures over two bars.

name: Three White Soldiers
description: Detects three consecutive bullish candles with higher closes — strong trend establishment.

name: MT5 Engulfing Pattern (with RSI confirmation)
description: MT5-sourced engulfing pattern with RSI(37) confirmation. Proven 2-candle reversal logic from MetaQuotes Free Robots.

name: MT5 Harami Pattern (with RSI confirmation)
description: MT5-sourced harami reversal pattern with RSI(37) confirmation.

name: MT5 Morning/Evening Star (with RSI confirmation)
description: MT5-sourced 3-candle reversal pattern (morning/evening star) with RSI(37) confirmation.

name: MT5 Hammer/Shooting Star (with RSI confirmation)
description: MT5-sourced hammer and shooting star reversal patterns with RSI(37) confirmation.

name: Pin Bar Pattern
description: Pin bar rejecting lower prices = support confirmed.

name: VIX Regime
description: Market-wide volatility regime. Low VIX = calm, high VIX = defensive.

name: DXY Regime
description: Dollar strength/weakness regime from DXY index. Gold, majors, commodities, and crypto are all correlated to USD strength.

name: Gold Macro Correlation
description: Gold vs USD strength (DXY), real yields (10Y), and safe-haven flows (VIX). Gold is the ultimate macro asset — DXY and real rates are the primary drivers.

name: CAD/USD Oil Correlation
description: CAD petrocurrency vs WTI crude oil and USD strength. Oil up = CAD up (USDCAD down). Covers all 5 CAD crosses.

name: Monday Effect
description: Monday bearish bias — statistically the worst day of the week for equities.

name: Friday Positioning
description: End-of-week profit-taking and position squaring.

name: Midweek Momentum
description: Tue-Thu historically strongest sessions for trend continuation.

name: Advanced Weekly Rhythm Composite
description: Day-of-week composite: Mon bearish, Tue-Thu bullish, Fri neutral.

name: SPY Options Expiry Effect
description: OpEx week detection via date proximity (3rd Friday of month).

name: SPY Month-End Rebalancing
description: Month-end institutional flow proxy (last 3 trading days).

name: SPY/QQQ Relative Strength
description: Symbol vs broad market momentum as relative strength proxy.

name: Crypto Fear & Greed Index
description: Contrarian sentiment from the Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index. Extreme fear (<25) = bullish. Extreme greed (>75) = bearish.

name: Bitcoin Halving Cycle
description: Scores BTC position in its 4-year halving cycle. Post-halving supply shock (0-180 days) = strongest signal. Late-cycle euphoria (540-900 days) = elevated. Pre-halving bear (900+ days) = suppressed.

name: Crypto Weekend Effect
description: Accounts for 24/7 crypto weekend dynamics: lower volume, wider spreads, manipulation risk on Saturdays/Sundays. Monday mornings offer recovery opportunities.

name: Market Regime Detection
description: Ensemble regime classifier: Hurst + ADX + volatility. Scores based on regime clarity and alignment.

name: Kelly Position Sizing
description: Scores position size against Kelly Criterion optimal allocation. Half-Kelly is the recommended standard.

name: Confidence-Weighted Sizing
description: Rewards high-confidence protocol scores with proportionally larger position sizes.

name: NVDA Earnings Momentum
description: NVDA-specific: post-earnings drift and momentum proxy.

name: TSLA Sentiment Amplifier
description: TSLA-specific: RSI extremes + volume surge detection.

name: Positive News Sentiment
description: Evaluates news sentiment. Mock-first — neutral when no API connected.

name: Earnings Proximity
description: Scores based on distance to earnings. Pre-earnings = uncertainty, post-earnings = volatility.

name: Attractive Dividend Yield
description: Low volatility proxy for dividend-paying stability.

name: Price Action
description: Scores price position relative to MA(20), MA(50), MA(200). Above all = bullish structure.

name: Confluence Reversal Combo
description: Composite: RSI oversold + reversal candle + near support.

name: ZigZag Swing Detector
description: Detects swing highs and lows using a 5-bar window with 0.4% minimum deviation. Scores bullish/bearish swing structure and proximity to recent swing levels. Foundation for Fibonacci retracement and dynamic S/R directives.

name: Fibonacci Retracements
description: Detects price position relative to Fibonacci retracement levels (23.6-78.6%) from recent swing points. Scores bounce/reversal signals for trend continuation or failure.

name: Support & Resistance Levels
description: Detects local S/R levels from swing pivots. Near support = bullish, near resistance = bearish.

name: Overhead Supply Pressure
description: Quantifies trapped overhead supply from recent top. Rewards reclaim progress.

name: Panic Exhaustion & Absorption
description: Detects panic → capitulation → exhaustion → stabilization sequence.

name: Time-Based Support
description: VWAP and round-number support/resistance levels.

name: ISA Reset
description: UK ISA tax-year reset timing (April 6th).

name: Portfolio Performance
description: Symbol-level momentum as proxy for portfolio contribution.

name: Basic Weekly Rhythm Composite
description: Day-of-week + volume pattern composite.

name: Intraday U-Pattern
description: U-shaped recovery: early weakness followed by afternoon strength.

name: Institutional Timing
description: Quarter-end and month-end institutional rebalancing proxy.

name: MACD (General)
description: Line/signal relationship, histogram, divergence.

name: Adaptive Risk Monitor
description: Dynamic position sizing from volatility regime.

name: Analyst Adjustments
description: Price momentum proxy for sentiment shifts (analyst revisions unavailable).

name: Conviction Growth
description: Multi-timeframe conviction for position scaling.

name: Earnings Strategy Implementation
description: Volatility compression proxy for pre-earnings positioning.

name: Earnings Whispers
description: Recent price gap as proxy for whisper surprise.

name: Zacks-Style Rank Proxy
description: Trend strength ranking from price momentum as earnings revision proxy.

name: Mean Reversion Strategy
description: Statistical mean reversion with regime filters.

name: Resistance Levels Strategy
description: Multi-timeframe resistance with breakout/failure scoring.

name: S&P 500 Regime Filter
description: Market regime proxy: bull/correction/bear/recovery from price vs SMA200.

name: VIX-Based Strategy
description: ATR percentile as VIX proxy for position sizing.

name: Weekly Rhythm Strategy
description: Day-of-week statistical edges for entry/exit timing.

name: Volatility Envelope
description: Percentile-based range bands. Shows whether current volatility is normal, unusual, or extreme.

name: Momentum Exhaustion
description: Detects fading momentum — RSI overbought + declining volume. Exit urgency signal.

name: Wick Filter
description: Detects fakeout wicks vs genuine breakouts. Uses ATR, volume, and multi-timeframe logic.

name: Target Achieved
description: Checks if price has reached ATR-based or swing-based profit targets.

name: Regime Shift Exit
description: Detects market structure breakdown via entropy spike. Urgent exit signal.

name: Time Stop
description: Position age exit signal. Longer hold = higher exit urgency.

name: Session Open Effect
description: Predicts directional bias around major session opens. US open at 13:30 UTC is the most impactful for crypto.

name: Budget Gate
description: Gates new trade entries when the signal budget is near exhaustion. Prevents over-trading.

name: Liquidity Check
description: Penalises illiquid symbols. Rewards symbols with stable volume, tight ranges, and low gap frequency.

name: Earnings Momentum
description: Scores earnings surprise magnitude and post-earnings estimate revision trends from stored EarningsEvent records.

name: Social Buzz
description: Scores social media sentiment and mention volume from Reddit/Twitter. Reads from SocialMention DB table (populated by cron).

name: Insider Activity
description: Scores insider buying/selling clusters. Cluster buying = strong bullish. On-demand import + DB read.

name: Dilution Impact
description: Penalises stocks with recent share dilution. No dilution = full score. On-demand import + DB read.

name: Rollover Risk
description: Detects broker rollover window (22:00–23:00 UTC) where spreads widen 2–5× normal. Scores 0 during this period to gate trades.
